cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Did the boss calling us office furniture hurt you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? Are you making a complaint?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It's still in drafts. How did you feel?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Invisible. I've worked here twelve years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. Mine says 'unprofessional'; I'm changing that to 'I went home and cried.'

mechanism: A runs the emotional inquiry as its only competent interviewer until B admits hurt first, then reveals shared hurt.
confusable: Detached interviewing differs from A needing B's vulnerability before allowing the matching disclosure.
comparison: A family cancellation prompts supermarket tears; workplace belittling prompts a more personal complaint draft.
seedUse: Keep B's first admission as the trigger for A's own rather than disclosing both in the opening.
